clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1 Scope — Manufacture and chemical and physical requirements of hydrophobic Portland cement. Note—Hydrophobic cement   deteriorates very  little during prolonged  storage under unfavourable conditions. This cement is obtained  by intergrinding 33 grade ordinary Portland cement clinker with  certain hydrophobic agents  which will impart to the cement a water repelling property. The hydrophobic properties are due  to the formation of a water repellant film around each particle  of cement. This film is broken during the mixing of the con  crete, and normal  hydration takes place. Hydrophobic cement  shall not be confused with water proofing cements.

clauses.title: Chemical Requirements
clauses.text: 2. Chemical Requirements—The chemical requirements hydrophobic cement shall be as laid in IS 269:1989*. *Ordinary portland cement 33 Grade (fourth revision). SUMMARY OF IS 8043 : 1991  HYDROPHOBIC PORTLAND CEMENT (Second Revision)

clauses.title: Fineness
clauses.text: 3.1Fineness — Specific surface shall not be less than 350 m2/kg.

clauses.title: Soundness and Setting Time
clauses.text: 3.2Soundness and Setting Time — Shall be as laid down IS 269:1989.

clauses.title: Compressive Strength
clauses.text: 3.3Compressive Strength a) 72 1 hours     Not less than    15.69 MPa b) 168 2 hours   Not less than       21.57 MPa c) 672 4 hours   Not less than       30.40 MPa

clauses.title: Delivery
clauses.text: 4. Delivery — Packed in specified bags of 50 kg or 25 kg net subject to tolerances specified in the standard. For detailed information, refer to IS 8043:1991 Specification for hydrophobic Portland cement (second revision). ± ± ±
